title: Notify each day's fuel prices in advance and hold them
what: Notify the Commissioner, as reg 3A requires, of each fuel's standard retail price for a day, and sell at that price for the whole day (the 24 hours from 6 am).

sources.title: Petroleum Products Pricing Regulations 2000 (WA)
sources.quote: Subject to subregulation (3), a person who offers a particular kind of motor fuel for retail sale on a particular day at a particular place commits an offence unless — (a) under subregulation (2), the person has established the permitted standard retail price for that sale; and (b) the standard retail price at which that kind of motor fuel is offered is that day’s permitted standard retail price

sources.title: Petroleum Products Pricing Regulations 2000 (WA)
sources.quote: A person establishes the permitted standard retail price for the retail sale by that person of a particular kind of motor fuel on a particular day at a particular place by notifying the Commissioner, in accordance with regulation 3A, of the standard retail price at which the motor fuel is to be offered for sale on that day
